text:
maya: Quick thread — sizing for the 70B q4f16 onboard across US/EU dedicated pools. We have p99 latency SLO 200ms. Can we agree on GPU counts + autoscale headroom?
sam: Bench summary from nightly: H100 (us-west): p50 14ms p99 72ms throughput 270 tok/s; A100 (eu-west): p50 22ms p99 110ms throughput 190 tok/s. q4f16 gives ~1.6x speed vs fp16 but adds kernel variance in longer seqs.
olivia: Any warmup differences by region? EU infra saw higher cold p99s earlier this week.
ryan: Paste from bench csv:
```
region,gpu,type,seq,p50_ms,p99_ms,tokens_s
us-west,H100,q4f16,512,14,72,270
eu-west,A100,q4f16,512,22,110,190
us-west,H100,fp16,512,13,65,290
eu-west,A100,fp16,512,21,100,205
```
infra-bot: nightly-bench job #2026 finished — results pushed to s3://redwood-bench/2026/70b-q4f16/
sam: Ops recommendation: target concurrency per GPU = 8 for H100, 5 for A100 to keep p99 < 180ms under typical mix. Plan: EU dedicated pool +2 GPUs for 20% headroom, US pool +1 GPU. Autoscale trigger at 75% concurrency for spin-up, cooldown 5m. Under sustained >90% route to q8 fallback variant.
olivia: Evaluation note: small regressions on the 'summarize-long' eval set — failure rate up 0.6% with q4f16 in eu-west p99 spikes. Need canary to monitor quality metrics.
maya: Okay. Next steps: run 72h canary in EU with +2 reserved GPUs, enable detailed token-level traces, and run nightly evals every 4h. Ops — can you reserve capacity?
ryan: ops-cli reserve --region eu-west --gpu a100 --count 2 --duration 72h  # will queue the reservation
infra-bot: reservation request queued (ticket RID-5123). ETA allocation 12h. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks — once reserved I'll kick off canary and post results here. :eyes:
